title: Sample Pooling Down Column
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required equipment
steps.instruction: Collect the following hardware and consumables: Opentrons OT‑2 robot (Run App version 3.19.0 or later), Opentrons P300 Single‑Channel GEN2 pipette (specify mount side), Opentrons 200 µL filter tip rack with 200 µL filter tips, a custom Opentrons 6 × 5 tube rack, and the appropriate tubes (T1‑T3 or T7 for rack A; T4‑T5 or T6 for rack B) as well as any reservoir or plate defined in the custom labware package.

steps.title: Download protocol package
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package that contains the custom labware definitions for the reservoir and plate.

steps.title: Upload labware definition
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 App, upload the labware definition file from the downloaded package.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file into the OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the robot deck as follows: Slot 1 – Tuberack A (if used), Slot 2 – Tuberack B (if used), Slot 4 – Opentrons 200 µL filter tip rack, matching the provided deck map.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Set the following options in the customizations field: choose whether to pool Tuberack A and/or Tuberack B, select the tube set for each rack (T1‑T3 or T7 for A; T4‑T5 or T6 for B), specify the number of pooling rows for each rack (1‑5), define the delay time after each aspiration in seconds (0 is allowed), and indicate the mount side for the P300 GEN2 pipette.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, run calibration routines for the tip rack, each tuberack, and the P300 pipette.

steps.title: Execute pooling protocol
steps.instruction: The robot will aspirate 100 µL from each well across a row and dispense it into the recipient tube located in column 6 of the same row, yielding a total of 500 µL in each recipient tube.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to begin the protocol.
